caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped metal object with three short legs and an open lattice-like structure. The main view is rendered in a grayish-brown tone, and there is an embossed inscription around the edge that reads "DOUBLE POINT MANT'U' COMFORT IRON" and "STRAUSS GAS IRON CO. PHILA. PA. S.A." In the center of the object is a relief of an iron (clothing iron) surrounded by decorative cut-out patterns. Above the main drawing are two additional views in lighter gray: one is a top-down plan of the object and the other is a simple side elevation showing the three legs. Near the side elevation is a small linear scale marked in inches. The background of the drawing is an off-white, lightly textured surface. At the bottom right corner, there is a handwritten signature that reads “Bernard Krieger.”
title: Flat Iron Holder
